manual_tests_required_on_real_device: Real GPS accuracy fix on physical phone (open /app/checkout, tap use-current-location, allow permission, verify pin lands within GPS accuracy circle of your true location and distance is realistic).
Real OS permission-prompt UI: verify the browser's native permission dialog appears once, and 'Block' persists across visits (Chrome Android and Safari iOS).

Background-tab throttling: with order out_for_delivery, background the /rider tab for 60s (screen off / switch app), then foreground and confirm the /api/delivery/{order_id}/location POST cadence recovers and the customer live map shows fresh rider position.
Google sign-in consent completion end-to-end: after this test we only confirm the redirect *begins*; actually finishing Google sign-in and returning to /app authenticated must be done manually.
iOS Safari specific: verify Leaflet touch pan/pinch-zoom behaves correctly with iOS gesture-handling and that momentum-scroll on the checkout page above/below the map is not swallowed.

Real Android WebView (if any wrapper is used): touch drag on leaflet-marker-draggable actually reaches Leaflet's L.Draggable via Pointer Events — Playwright's touchscreen path exercises the code but does not guarantee identical behavior in every WebView.

Consider making drawer testids unique (e.g. drawer-nav-orders) to help future automation, though functionally both currently reach the same route.
